meta.title: Tool deny
meta.description: Hide or refuse tools per agent preset. Open this plugin's page in Plugins to use the Built-in tools by preset table: columns are agent presets, rows are DSH built-in tools (@deepseek-ai packages), green shows a tool and red hides it. Clicking a dot asks for confirmation, then saves only hideByPreset in this plugin's row. Tools a plugin registers per agent cannot be hidden. Turning the plugin off shows every tool again.
